dogecoin.text:
@SCarolinaCiara Over the weekend, I was listening to a financial expert on the radio.  He was talking about Bitcoin, specifically, but I think Dogecoin is similar.  Long story short, his advice was DON'T invest in these things if you live in a country with a strong currency.  
1/2

We live in odd times.  People can simply create a monetary currency out of thin air (Bitcoin, Dogecoin).  If they can do that, someone with half the talent should be able to create a girlfriend for me.  How difficult can it be?
